title: Build a Guru alternative with Claude: free internal knowledge base spec, 31/31 checks passed
description:
Claude built a Guru alternative from one Markdown spec: all 31 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 155 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 30 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for an internal knowledge base for teams of 5 to 80 people and had it build the tool in four phases: people, teams, collections and sign-in; cards, trust and flags; search, insights and the export; and notifications, review reminders and a /kb Slack command. The core rule is trust: it is never stored but worked out every time a card is shown, and a card turns unverified when its owner leaves, when someone flags it, when someone else edits it, or when its review date passes. The gaps included nothing saying whether the last admin could be deactivated, search turning "does" into "doe" because the spec never said when to remove stop words, and card text with a channel-wide mention that could notify everyone in a Slack channel. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when Guru is still the better buy.
